points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 开普勒出生于符腾堡公国的魏尔市，早产儿且体弱多病。尽管家境贫寒，但他凭借出色的数学才能获得了奖学金，先后在符腾堡的毛尔布龙修道院学校和蒂宾根大学学习。在蒂宾根大学，他受到天文学教授马斯特林的指导，接受了哥白尼的日心说理论，这成为他后来天文学研究的基础。这段时期，他不仅学习了数学、哲学和神学，还开始思考宇宙的和谐结构。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Weil der Stadt, Württemberg, Kepler was a premature child and suffered from various illnesses throughout his life. Despite his family's financial difficulties, his exceptional mathematical abilities earned him scholarships, allowing him to study at the Maulbronn Seminary and later at the University of Tübingen. At Tübingen, he was taught astronomy by Michael Maestlin and became a convert to the Copernican heliocentric theory, which would form the foundation of his later astronomical work. During this period, he studied mathematics, philosophy, and theology, while beginning to contemplate the harmonious structure of the universe.

points.title: 数学教师与天文研究
points.description: 开普勒被任命为格拉茨的新教学校数学教师，尽管他更希望担任神职。在这里，他开始独立进行天文研究，并尝试将哥白尼理论与毕达哥拉斯的宇宙和谐理念相结合。1595年，他发表了《宇宙的奥秘》，提出了行星轨道与五种正多面体相关的宇宙模型。尽管这个模型后来被证明是错误的，但展示了开普勒对宇宙和谐的深刻思考。此外，他还发表了《前维特利奥星表》，并开始研究火星运动，这为他后来发现行星运动定律奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Appointed as a mathematics teacher at the Protestant school in Graz, though he had hoped for a position in the church. Here, he began independent astronomical research, attempting to combine Copernican theory with Pythagorean ideas of cosmic harmony. In 1595, he published 'Mysterium Cosmographicum,' proposing a model of the universe where planetary orbits were related to the five Platonic solids. Although this model was later proven incorrect, it demonstrated Kepler's deep thinking about cosmic harmony. He also published the 'Prodromus Dissertationum Mathematicarum' and began his study of Mars' motion, laying the foundation for his later discovery of the laws of planetary motion.

points.title: 皇家天文学家
points.description: 开普勒应第谷·布拉赫的邀请前往布拉格，成为其助手。第谷去世后，开普勒接替他成为神圣罗马帝国皇帝鲁道夫二世的皇家数学家。这一时期是开普勒科学成就最辉煌的阶段。他继承了第谷精确的天文观测数据，经过多年研究，在1609年发表了《新天文学》，提出了行星运动第一和第二定律。他还完成了《鲁道夫星表》，成为当时最精确的星表。此外，他研究了光的折射，为后来光学发展做出贡献。布拉格时期，开普勒还卷入了宗教和政治冲突，被迫离开新教立场，这对他个人生活产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Invited by Tycho Brahe to Prague, Kepler became his assistant. After Tycho's death, Kepler succeeded him as Imperial Mathematician to Holy Roman Emperor Rudolf II. This period marked Kepler's most fruitful scientific achievements. Inheriting Tycho's precise astronomical data, he published 'Astronomia Nova' in 1609, proposing the first and second laws of planetary motion. He also completed the 'Rudolphine Tables,' the most accurate star catalog of the time. Additionally, he studied the refraction of light, contributing to the later development of optics. During his Prague years, Kepler was also embroiled in religious and political conflicts, forcing him to abandon his Protestant stance, which profoundly affected his personal life.

points.title: 教学与著作
points.description: 鲁道夫二世退位后，开普勒移居林茨，担任数学教师和地区数学家。在这里，他完成了《哥白尼天文学概要》，系统阐述了哥白尼理论并加入了行星运动定律。1619年，他发表了《宇宙和谐论》，提出了行星运动第三定律，揭示了行星轨道周期与轨道大小之间的关系。他还发表了《折射光学》，深入研究光的性质。在林茨期间，开普勒面临个人困境，包括妻子去世、母亲被控巫术等挑战，但他仍坚持科学研究，同时参与历法改革和土地测量工作。这一时期，他的著作开始产生更广泛的影响，为牛顿后来发现万有引力定律奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After Rudolf II's abdication, Kepler moved to Linz, where he served as a mathematics teacher and district mathematician. Here, he completed 'Epitome of Copernican Astronomy,' systematically explaining Copernican theory and incorporating his laws of planetary motion. In 1619, he published 'Harmonices Mundi,' proposing the third law of planetary motion, revealing the relationship between planetary orbital periods and their distances from the sun. He also published 'Dioptrice,' an in-depth study of optical properties. During his Linz years, Kepler faced personal challenges including his wife's death and his mother's trial for witchcraft, yet he persisted in scientific research while participating in calendar reform and land surveying. His works during this period began to have broader influence, laying the groundwork for Newton's later discovery of the law of universal gravitation.

points.title: 晚年与逝世
points.description: 开普勒晚年移居雷根斯堡，继续从事科学研究和写作。他试图完成一部综合性的天文学著作，但未能完成。1630年，开普勒前往雷根斯堡帝国议会寻求拖欠的薪水，不幸在此地因高烧去世，享年58岁。尽管生前未能完全获得应有的认可，但开普勒的科学遗产在他去世后逐渐被重视。他的行星运动定律成为现代天文学的基础，为牛顿万有引力定律提供了关键支持。开普勒的研究方法结合了数学精确性和对自然和谐的追求，体现了科学革命时期的思想转变。他被后世誉为'天空立法者'，其工作彻底改变了人类对宇宙的理解。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Kepler moved to Regensburg, continuing his scientific research and writing. He attempted to complete a comprehensive astronomical work but was unable to finish it. In 1630, Kepler traveled to Regensburg to seek unpaid salary from the Imperial Diet, where he died of a fever at the age of 58. Although he did not receive full recognition during his lifetime, Kepler's scientific legacy gradually gained importance after his death. His laws of planetary motion became the foundation of modern astronomy, providing crucial support for Newton's law of universal gravitation. Kepler's research methods combined mathematical precision with a pursuit of natural harmony, reflecting the intellectual transformation of the Scientific Revolution. He is later honored as the 'Lawgiver of the Heavens,' and his work fundamentally changed humanity's understanding of the universe.

supporter.zh: 开普勒被誉为科学革命的巨人，他通过严谨的数学分析和精确的天文观测，揭示了行星运动的规律，彻底改变了人类对宇宙的认知。他的行星运动定律不仅为牛顿发现万有引力奠定了基础，还体现了科学方法的核心——从数据中寻找规律。开普勒的工作展示了数学之美与自然和谐的统一，他的宇宙观融合了科学探索与神秘主义，体现了文艺复兴时期思想的复杂性。作为'天空立法者'，开普勒的成就超越了时代限制，成为现代天文学的奠基人之一。
supporter.en: Kepler is celebrated as a giant of the Scientific Revolution who, through rigorous mathematical analysis and precise astronomical observations, revealed the laws of planetary motion, fundamentally changing humanity's understanding of the cosmos. His laws of planetary motion not only laid the foundation for Newton's discovery of universal gravitation but embodied the core of the scientific method—finding patterns in data. Kepler's work demonstrated the unity of mathematical beauty and natural harmony, and his worldview blended scientific exploration with mysticism, reflecting the complexity of Renaissance thought. As the 'Lawgiver of the Heavens,' Kepler's achievements transcended the limitations of his time, establishing him as one of the founders of modern astronomy.

critic.zh: 批评者指出开普勒的科学方法存在局限性，他过度依赖神秘主义和数字命理学，如他的宇宙和谐论和正多面体模型。他的研究过程也受到个人偏见和宗教信仰的影响，例如在解释火星轨道时，他最初试图将圆形轨道理论与观测数据调和，而非完全接受椭圆轨道。此外，开普勒在处理与第谷·布拉赫的关系中有时表现出不诚实，如未经许可使用第谷的数据。这些批评者认为，尽管开普勒最终取得了突破，但他的科学道路并非完全理性，而是充满了个人挣扎和思想矛盾。
critic.en: Critics point out that Kepler's scientific methods had limitations, as he relied excessively on mysticism and numerology, such as in his theories of cosmic harmony and Platonic solids. His research process was also influenced by personal biases and religious beliefs; for example, when explaining Mars' orbit, he initially attempted to reconcile circular orbital theory with observational data rather than fully accepting elliptical orbits. Additionally, Kepler sometimes acted dishonestly in his relationship with Tycho Brahe, such as using Tycho's data without permission. These critics argue that while Kepler ultimately achieved breakthroughs, his scientific path was not entirely rational but was filled with personal struggles and intellectual contradictions.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，开普勒代表了科学革命时期思想转变的关键人物。他既继承了古代天文学的神秘传统，又开创了现代科学方法，体现了科学思想的演进。在学术界，他被视为从哥白尼到牛顿之间的重要桥梁，其行星运动定律成为经典力学的基础。在流行文化中，开普勒常被描绘为孤独的天才，与宗教和政治斗争作斗争的科学家。他的生平故事融合了科学发现、个人悲剧和社会变革，使他成为科学史上最具魅力的人物之一。现代科学界对开普勒的评价已超越其具体发现，更重视他如何将数学、物理和哲学融合，开创了跨学科研究的先河。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Kepler represents a pivotal figure in the intellectual transformation of the Scientific Revolution. He inherited the mystical traditions of ancient astronomy while pioneering modern scientific methods, embodying the evolution of scientific thought. In academia, he is regarded as a crucial bridge between Copernicus and Newton, with his laws of planetary motion forming the foundation of classical mechanics. In popular culture, Kepler is often depicted as a lonely genius, a scientist struggling against religious and political conflicts. His life story blends scientific discovery, personal tragedy, and social change, making him one of the most compelling figures in the history of science. Modern scientific evaluations of Kepler have transcended his specific discoveries, focusing instead on how he integrated mathematics, physics, and philosophy, pioneering interdisciplinary research.

self.zh: 天文学是数学的诗歌，几何学是视觉的音乐。
self.en: Astronomy is the poetry of the mathematical sciences, and geometry is the music of the visual arts.

others.zh: 开普勒是第一个真正理解天空的人，他不仅看到了行星的运动，还理解了支配这些运动的数学规律。
others.en: Kepler was the first man to understand the sky, not only seeing the motion of the planets but understanding the mathematical laws that governed them.
